title: Roll Out Imagined Latent Trajectories
summary: Start imagination from one known latent state and propagate using actions and learned dynamics only.

frames: Declared normalized action/feature coordinates; no implicit frame conversion

units.values: Latents and normalized actions are dimensionless. Rewards/values use a fixed caller-declared dimensionless reward scale; KL is measured in nats.

physical_contract.axes: Batch, categorical-group, category, rollout-time and latent axes are defined in the contract
physical_contract.timestamp_assumptions: Each ordered index is one fixed caller-declared control interval. Predicted continuation is a probability, not an elapsed duration. No implicit frame conversion.
physical_contract.batching: Batch, categorical-group, category, rollout-time and latent axes are defined in the contract

provenance.authoring_notes: A bounded component with supplied tensors. Prediction loss inputs and deterministic imagined dynamics do not reproduce the complete trained recurrent stochastic world model, actor or benchmark.
